parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the use of this binding on the device.

parameters.name: SourceEndpoint
parameters.description: Specifies the source endpoint used in this binding entry.

parameters.name: SourceAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the source address used in this binding entry.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: Specifies the cluster identifier used in this binding entry.

parameters.name: DestinationAddressMode
parameters.description: Specifies the type of destination address used for this binding entry. {{enum}}

parameters.name: DestinationEndpoint
parameters.description: Specifies the destination endpoint for the binding entry. The value of this field is valid when the value of the {{param|DestinationAddressMode}} is {{enum|Endpoint|DestinationAddressMode}}.

parameters.name: IEEEDestinationAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the IEEE destination address for this binding entry. The value of this field is valid when the value of the {{param|DestinationAddressMode}} is {{enum|Endpoint|DestinationAddressMode}}.

parameters.name: GroupDestinationAddress
parameters.description: Specifies the group destination address for this binding entry. The value of this field is valid when the value of the {{param|DestinationAddressMode}} is {{enum|Group|DestinationAddressMode}}.

object.description: The {{object}} object describes the configuration capabilities related to maintaining a ZigBee Device's Binding Table as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.2.8.2 Binding}}.
